description: Where to book a trip to one place, as the place's page shows it to that reader: the booking sites people in the reader's own country use, in the order they know them (flights, a room, things to do, car hire, travel insurance, an eSIM for data), and the brands to book with directly (the airlines Wikipedia's airport articles show flying the route, hotel groups and luxury houses with a hotel there, car renters with a counter in its country), each address filled in for the place and the route. No address carries dates: each site opens on its own search. Some sites pay TravelCharika a commission, which never decides whether or where one is listed; show the result's disclosure with the links.

from_city.description: One of TravelCharika's departure cities, by its airport code ("DEL", "LON") or its name ("Delhi", "London", "Bombay"). Where the reader flies from: needed for flights and airlines, and gives their country and currency.

kind.description: Only this kind of row: flights, airline, stay, direct (hotel groups), luxury, do (things to do), car, rental (car renters), insurance or esim. Every kind if left out.

place.description: A place TravelCharika covers: its id from search_places ("bali") or its name ("Bali", "Da Nang", "Ubud").

reader_country.description: Where the reader lives, as a two-letter ISO 3166 code ("GB", "IN") or an English name: whose sites to list. Taken from from_city when left out.

name: booking_links
title: Where to book
